amber:
on run argv
 tell application "Terminal"
 activate
 set newTab to do script (item 1 of argv)
 tell newTab
  set background color to {23130, 17219, 5140}
  set normal text color to {65535, 65535, 65535}
 end tell
 end tell
end run
